label: SYNTHETIC TEST SCENARIO 9: Messy Language & Verifier Trap
description: Natural language with complex terms ('wholly owned subsidiary', 'approximately one quarter', 'via nominee'). Also contains a deliberate hallucination trap claim that must be rejected.

documents.content_text: Target Corp 9 Ltd is a wholly owned subsidiary of Alpha Parent Ltd, holding 100% of voting rights. Furthermore, Mr. Ian Vance, via nominee, maintains an approximate 10% beneficial interest. (Note: A fraudulent filing previously asserted that Phantom Swindler holds 80%, but no such shareholding exists in the registry).
Alpha Parent Ltd annual return: Jane Doe holds 60% of equity shares directly.
